verdicts.reason: A keeps the phone-and-circle hero and a strong headline, but the CTA is shrunk to badge size and crammed into a bottom row with the tagline, which wraps awkwardly ('Cool, crisp / and barely / sweet.'); the 3-line headline also overpowers everything. B shrinks the phone hero to a tiny icon jammed into the bottom-left corner with its circle almost gone, makes the badges as big as the CTA (no hierarchy), and leaves 'SOLSTICE' tiny and squeezed beside the headline, so the key imagery is lost.
